verdict.rationale: Wave's pricing docs show that one owner can run several businesses, each signed up and subscribed separately, so separate-entity management has thin first-party support. Nothing documents consolidated financials: the reports evidence (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, period comparisons) is per business. missing for 10: consolidated or combined financial statements across entities, intercompany eliminations, a documented multi-entity switching or management workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: The subscription fee for the Pro Plan is per business, not per owner... you'd sign each business up and subscribe to and pay $19 USD... times
Generate your profit & loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow report automatically—no spreadsheets required.
